name: Marinol
aliases: dronabinol, syndros, cesamet, δ9-thc, δ9--tetrahydrocannabinol, delta9-tetrahydrocannabinol, delta9-thc
summary: Synthetically created Δ9-THC, the main psychoactive ingredient in cannabis.

uses.text: Dronabinol (INN), sold under the brand names Marinol and Syndros, is the generic name for the molecule of (−)-trans-Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) in the pharmaceutical context. It has indications as an appetite stimulant and antiemetic and is approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as safe and effective for HIV/AIDS-induced anorexia and chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects of dronabinol include euphoria, drowsiness, dizziness, decreased motor coordination, anxiety, paranoia, confusion, and a rapid heartbeat, among others.

summaryZh: 屈大麻酚以商品名Marinol與Syndros販售，當藥物使用時，是學名-trans-Δ9-四氫大麻酚的分子。它可以當成食慾刺激劑與止吐劑，並已取得美國食品藥品監督管理局的醫療使用許可，用於治療愛滋病引起的食慾不振與化學治療引起的噁心與嘔吐。

pharmacology.en: Dronabinol is THC. It activates CB1 cannabinoid receptors in the brain, which accounts for its effects on mood, appetite and nausea, and it also acts on CB2 receptors in the immune system.
pharmacology.zh: 屈大麻酚就是 THC。它會活化腦中的 CB1 大麻素受體，這是它影響情緒、食慾與噁心的原因，它也會作用於免疫系統中的 CB2 受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 屈大麻酚就是 THC。它会活化脑中的 CB1 大麻素受体，这是它影响情绪、食欲与恶心的原因，它也会作用于免疫系统中的 CB2 受体。

fact.en: Dronabinol was approved in the United States in 1985, making synthetic THC one of the first cannabis compounds sold as a prescription medicine.
fact.zh: 屈大麻酚在1985年獲美國核准，使合成 THC 成為最早以處方藥販售的大麻成分之一。
fact.zhHans: 屈大麻酚在1985年获美国核准，使合成 THC 成为最早以处方药贩售的大麻成分之一。
